nodes.Name: matchZoneKey
nodes.DocComment:
matchZoneKey checks if stdname and dstname match the corresponding key
values "MUI_Std" and "MUI_Dlt" or "Std" and "Dlt" in the kname key stored
under the open registry key zones.

nodes.Name: toEnglishName
nodes.DocComment:
toEnglishName searches the registry for an English name of a time zone
whose zone names are stdname and dstname and returns the English name.

nodes.Name: extractCAPS
nodes.DocComment: extractCAPS extracts capital letters from description desc.

nodes.Name: abbrev
nodes.DocComment: abbrev returns the abbreviations to use for the given zone z.

nodes.Name: pseudoUnix
nodes.DocComment:
pseudoUnix returns the pseudo-Unix time (seconds since Jan 1 1970 *LOCAL TIME*)
denoted by the system date+time d in the given year.
It is up to the caller to convert this local time into a UTC-based time.

nodes.Name: usPacific
